entries.title: Ashen
entries.definitive_edition: Ashen on Windows PC with Nightstorm Isle DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Nightstorm Isle installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with the DLC expansion.

primary.version: Base game plus Nightstorm Isle DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because it covers the base A44/Annapurna action RPG and the Nightstorm Isle expansion while preserving PC settings and capture flexibility. Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch also received the game and DLC, but no sourced platform-exclusive story or mission content is documented over the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Ashen on Windows PC and install the Nightstorm Isle DLC. Play the DLC when ready; the official DLC guidance says it can be experienced at any point, with lore-minded players recommended to complete Jokell's Birthright side journey first.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; install Nightstorm Isle for the major expansion content.
